# Keld

> Keld is a desktop framework with a Rust host, supervised Bun app process, system webviews, typed kipc, and host-enforced default-deny permissions.

This file is generated from tracked authoritative Markdown by `tools/llms_docs.rs`; do not edit it by hand. The full ordered corpus is in [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

## Start here

- [Quickstart](docs/onboarding/README.md): Set up the workspace, run the implemented commands, and verify a change.

- [01 — Overview](docs/architecture/01-overview.md): System boundaries, design principles, crate topology, and performance budgets.

- [02 — IPC](docs/architecture/02-ipc.md): kipc topology, framing, codecs, channels, and lifecycle semantics.

- [03 — Security](docs/architecture/03-security.md): Principals, capabilities, default-deny enforcement, and update security.

- [04 — Electron compatibility](docs/architecture/04-electron-compat.md): Migration flow, compatibility tiers, native modules, and corpus measurement.

- [05 — Webview and native](docs/architecture/05-webview-and-native.md): WebEngine policy, renderer bridge, native APIs, and plugin boundaries.

- [06 — Runtime and tooling](docs/architecture/06-runtime-and-tooling.md): Supervised Bun runtime, CLI, packaging, updates, and development loop.

- [07 — Agent experience](docs/architecture/07-agent-experience.md): Agent-facing errors, docs, MCP tools, evals, and CLI contracts.
